seo_title: Wedding Videographer & Photographer Chesterfield | Zen Visuals
seo_description: Wedding films and photography in Chesterfield and north Derbyshire by Zuzia and Ben, 35 minutes away in Belper. Whole day from £1,000. Check your date.
h1: Wedding videographer and photographer in Chesterfield
hero_alt: Couple kissing in a shaft of light inside an old barn
intro: Chesterfield is thirty-five minutes north of us in Belper, and with Sheffield and the eastern Peak on its doorstep it has a wide choice of wedding venues, from grand halls to converted barns. We're Zuzia and Ben, and we photograph and film your whole day for one price.

sections.heading: Weddings around Chesterfield
sections.text: Couples marrying around Chesterfield choose venues such as Ringwood Hall, Casa Hotel, Peak Edge Hotel, Hardwick Hall's grounds, Bolsover Castle, and the barns and churches of Ashover, Wingerworth, Holymoorside and Dronfield.

sections.heading: What you get
sections.text: Wedding photography of your whole day is £1,000. A 3–6 minute wedding film is £1,400. Both together are £2,200, saving £200.

sections.heading: The day as it happened
sections.text: We don't stage your wedding. We film and photograph the real moments, from the morning to the last dance, and edit them into a film you'll want to watch every anniversary.

sections.heading: Thirty-five minutes from home
sections.text: Chesterfield, Dronfield, Bolsover and Clay Cross are all within easy reach of Belper, and we cover Sheffield and the rest of the UK too.

faqs.question: Do you cover Chesterfield weddings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Chesterfield and north Derbyshire are within easy reach of us in Belper.

faqs.question: How much does a wedding videographer cost in Chesterfield?
faqs.answer: Our wedding film is £1,400 for your whole day, and photography and film together is £2,200.

faqs.question: Do you also cover Sheffield?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sheffield is under an hour from us and we're happy to travel there.
